subject: PearlFin: context needs & model-fit kickoff
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-19T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: PearlFin kickoff — context samples + action items

Hannah / Ben —

Quick handoff for PearlFin (PF-4892). They’ve completed discovery and shared a set of sample prompts and session traces — attaching a trimmed token sample (PearlFin_prod_token_samples.csv) and the first draft of the mutual action plan. High level: they need an assistant for document search + summarization, and an encoded-embedding rerank step for results.

What we need from implementation:
- Confirm model shortlist and recommended context window for the search use case (they do ~1–3 doc lookups + a 200–800 token user prompt on average).
- Rough token-volume forecast for month 1 and steady state (they expect 10k active users by Q4 if pilot looks good).
- Any red flags on latency/SLA or data residency we should surface to procurement.

Ben, can you run a quick token-profile estimate from the attached CSV and drop a first-pass throughput/latency note? Hannah, I’ll let you own the implementation plan and M A P updates.

Deliverables requested by end of week: updated mutual_action_plan_v1.docx with model shortlist + traffic bands, and a Drive link with the token-profile CSV results.

Thanks —
Grace

Grace O'Connor
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Diane Park <diane@pearlfin.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PearlFin kickoff — context samples + action items

Thanks Grace — looping Diane in for confirmation on sample shape. Summary / plan from my side:

1) Candidate model slate (initial shortlist for evaluation):
   - Option A (latency-forward): Llama2-13b-q4f16 (quantized) — good token economics, faster on <16GB GPU pools.
   - Option B (cost-quality middle): Mixtral-8x7b (fp16) — balanced throughput and instruction following for summarization.
   - Option C (quality-led fallback): GPT4o-style private-hosted variant (if SLA demands higher coherence on long docs).

2) Context window recommendation: start with a 4k working window for the retriever+generator path (document snippets + prompt). If early eval shows longer document needs, move to 8k for the generator only and rely on streamable snippets.

3) Token forecast (rough, pending Ben’s detailed parse):
   - Pilot month (10k MAU target for limited cohort): ~45–60M input tokens, ~18–30M generated tokens (heavy summarization scenarios at 2–3x output/input).
   - Steady state (10k MAU productized): ~120–200M input tokens / month, ~60–120M output tokens / month.

Assumptions here: average prompt + context per session ~600 tokens, avg generated summary ~300–900 tokens depending on document length. Ben — please attach the first-pass CSV (initial_token_profile_estimate.csv) and note expected QPS for a 99th-percentile latency target of 400ms per request. Karthik — please flag any model variants that need dedicated capacity (e.g., private model for PF).

Next steps: Diane — can you confirm average session size and whether users upload full docs or snippets? If they upload whole documents we need to adjust the working set.

—Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0221
From: Diane Park <diane@pearlfin.co>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: integrations@pearlfin.co
Date: 2027-05-20T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PearlFin kickoff — context samples + action items

Thanks — quick answers from our side:

- Typical session: user query + up to 3 attached result snippets (we currently upload full doc text but will trim to relevant sections in the product update next month).
- Average prompt (user query + metadata) ~180 tokens. Average document snippet ~320 tokens. Typical session total incoming tokens median ~700, 90th percentile ~1,800.
- Example prompt set attached (pearlfin_prompt_samples.txt) — shows mix of short queries and long comparison tasks.

We do need GDPR-friendly handling and prefer EU region for customer data, but pilot users will be US-only (we can discuss cross-region for Q4).

Happy to jump on a 30-minute tech sync if that helps.

—Diane Park
Head of Product, PearlFin Analytics
diane@pearlfin.co
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Diane Park <diane@pearlfin.co>
Date: 2027-05-20T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PearlFin kickoff — token profile & throughput notes

Attached is the quick parse (initial_token_profile_estimate.csv) from the samples — high level notes:

- Observed avg incoming tokens per session: 720; median 680; 95th pct 1,760 — matches Diane's numbers.
- Suggested batching / runtime knobs for pilot: continuous batching with 16–32 token batch windows (aggressive) or 8–12 token windows for tighter 400ms p99 target.
- Throughput implications (ballpark for our hosted inference S1 profile):
   * Llama2-13b-q4f16 — ~11–13 req/sec per GPU at p50 120ms, p95 ~420ms with 600-token average output; good cost profile.
   * Mixtral-8x7b — ~18–22 req/sec per GPU for typical 600-token average; slightly higher memory but better instruction quality.
   * GPT4o-style private variant — needs dedicated 2x nodes for pilot to meet p95 400ms.

Cost note (very rough): pilot (10k MAU, 45–60M in / 18–30M out) => expected hosted inference spend ~$18–28k/month depending on model mix and batching. We should build cost scenarios in the MAP doc.

Attachments: latency_sla_notes.pdf outlines how batching and prefix cache will change p95 behavior.

Let me know if you want a quick benchmark run on a matched 600-token generation sample — I can spin it today.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Diane Park <diane@pearlfin.co>
Date: 2027-05-21T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PearlFin kickoff — context samples + action items

Thanks everyone — summary and action items (finalizing into MAP):

- Model shortlist for pilot: Mixtral-8x7b as default, Llama2-13b-q4f16 as cost-optimized fallback, gated private GPT4o-style for high-coherence flows. (Ben to add perf numbers to the MAP.)
- Working window: 4k for retriever+generator path. If PearlFin moves to full-doc uploads for users we’ll re-evaluate 8k generator path.
- Pilot traffic bands (conservative): 45–60M in / 18–30M out tokens per month; steady-state scenario to be modeled in the MAP.
- Regional note: PearlFin prefers EU for customer data long-term; pilot will remain US region — Karthik to add a private-deploy checklist if they opt-in for EU residency.

Open items / owners:
- Ben: attach benchmark CSV and final latency SLO table in MAP (due EOW).
- Grace: update mutual_action_plan_v1.docx with traffic bands and model slate (due EOW).
- Diane: confirm if product plan will move to snippet-only uploads (reply by 2027-05-26).
- Karthik: draft EU private-deploy checklist and estimated timeline (tentative).

If that looks right I’ll create a short tech sync invite for Wednesday to lock the pilot config.
